decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits in the core dairy range and is cheap to carry, so the option is worth keeping despite no website mentions in 2020 and 2021.
The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the established range and costs little to maintain, although the lack of later evidence makes its value doubtful.

After four years with no further signals, and with the similar flavoured cheese B already withdrawn, the uncertainty about this multi-variant spicy line has resolved unfavourably, and its several variants tie up resources amid 2022 cost pressures.
The mild creamy soft cheese rounds out the soft-cheese range at low incremental cost, so keeping it remains a cheap option despite limited evidence.
The niche washed-rind soft cheese has shown no evidence of value since launch, so with rising energy and milk costs the option is better abandoned and its resources moved to core business.
